tasks.name: החצי הראשון הפוך
tasks.src: l=>l.slice(0,l.length>>1).reverse()
tasks.note: Keeps the front half (without the middle element of an odd list) in reverse order.

tasks.name: המקומות 1 ו-3
tasks.note: Keeps the elements at positions 1 and 3.

tasks.name: החלפת שני האחרונים
tasks.src: l=>l.length<2?[...l]:[...l.slice(0,-2),l[l.length-1],l[l.length-2]]
tasks.note: Swaps the last two elements.

tasks.name: בלי כל שלישי
tasks.src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>i%3!==2)
tasks.note: Drops the elements at positions 2, 5 and 8.

tasks.name: הקטן והגדול
tasks.src: l=>l.length<2?[...l]:[Math.min(...l),Math.max(...l)]
tasks.note: Returns the smallest element followed by the largest one.

tasks.name: ה-8 לראש
tasks.src: l=>l.includes(8)?[8,...l.filter(x=>x!==8)]:[...l]
tasks.note: Moves the element 8, when present, to the front.

tasks.name: הזוגיים הפוכים
tasks.src: l=>l.filter(x=>x%2===0).reverse()
tasks.note: Keeps the even elements in reverse order.

tasks.name: הפוך אם האורך זוגי
tasks.src: l=>l.length%2===0?[...l].reverse():[...l]
tasks.note: Reverses the list when its length is even, otherwise leaves it.

tasks.name: אחרי ה-12
tasks.src: l=>l.slice(l.indexOf(12)+1)
tasks.note: Keeps what comes after the element 12, or the whole list if 12 is absent.

tasks.name: הראשוניים
tasks.note: Keeps the prime elements.

tasks.name: מיון לפי ביטים הפוכים
tasks.note: Sorts by the value read with its four bits in reverse order.

tasks.name: החלפת שני הגדולים
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a), r=[...l], i=l.indexOf(s[0]), j=l.indexOf(s[1]); r[i]=s[1]; r[j]=s[0]; return r; }
tasks.note: Swaps the positions of the largest and the second largest elements.

tasks.name: המקסימום צעד שמאלה
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l], i=r.indexOf(Math.max(...r)); if(i>0){ const t=r[i-1]; r[i-1]=r[i]; r[i]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Swaps the largest element with its left neighbour.

tasks.name: מיון בתוך זוגות
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let i=0;i+1<r.length;i+=2) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Puts each consecutive pair (positions 0-1, 2-3, ...) in increasing order.

tasks.name: מיון לפי מספר מחלקים
tasks.src: l=>{ const dv=x=>{ let c=0; for(let d=1;d<=x;d++) if(x%d===0) c++; return c; }; return [...l].sort((a,b)=>dv(a)-dv(b)); }
tasks.note: Sorts by the number of divisors, keeping the original order on ties.

tasks.name: הפוך את החצי השני
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=l.length>>1; return [...l.slice(0,h),...l.slice(h).reverse()]; }
tasks.note: Reverses the back half (with the middle element of an odd list) and leaves the front half.

tasks.name: מיון בלוקים של ארבעה
tasks.src: l=>[...l.slice(0,4).sort((a,b)=>a-b),...l.slice(4).sort((a,b)=>a-b)]
tasks.note: Sorts the first four elements and the rest separately, each ascending.

tasks.name: מסכת הראשון
tasks.note: Keeps the element at position i when bit i of the first element is set.

tasks.name: מעל ממוצע השכנים
tasks.src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>i>0&&i<l.length-1&&2*x>l[i-1]+l[i+1])
tasks.note: Keeps inner elements that are larger than the average of their two neighbours.

tasks.name: הראשון לאמצע
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; const r=l.slice(1), m=r.length>>1; return [...r.slice(0,m),l[0],...r.slice(m)]; }
tasks.note: Moves the first element to the middle of the remaining ones.

tasks.name: מתחלק במקום
tasks.note: Keeps elements divisible by their position counted from 1.

tasks.name: בלי הקרוב לממוצע
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length; if(!n) return []; const s=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); let b=0; for(let i=1;i<n;i++) if(Math.abs(l[i]*n-s)<Math.abs(l[b]*n-s)) b=i; return l.filter((x,i)=>i!==b); }
tasks.note: Removes the element closest to the mean (the first on ties).

tasks.name: עד הירידה השנייה
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) if(l[i]<l[i-1]&&++c===2) return l.slice(0,i); return [...l]; }
tasks.note: Keeps everything before the second place where an element is smaller than the one before it.

tasks.name: ערימה
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=[]; for(const x of l){ h.push(x); let i=h.length-1; while(i>0&&h[(i-1)>>1]<h[i]){ const p=(i-1)>>1, t=h[p]; h[p]=h[i]; h[i]=t; i=p; } } return h; }
tasks.note: Inserts the elements one by one into a binary max-heap stored as an array and returns that array.

tasks.name: עץ חיפוש לפי רמות
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const L=[], R=[]; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++){ let p=0; for(;;){ const s=l[i]<l[p]?L:R; if(s[p]===undefined){ s[p]=i; break; } p=s[p]; } } const r=[], q=[0]; while(q.length){ const p=q.shift(); r.push(l[p]); if(L[p]!==undefined) q.push(L[p]); if(R[p]!==undefined) q.push(R[p]); } return r; }
tasks.note: Inserts the elements in order into a binary search tree and lists it level by level, left to right.

tasks.name: טורניר
tasks.src: l=>{ let a=[...l]; const r=[]; while(a.length>1){ const b=[]; for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=2){ if(i+1<a.length){ r.push(Math.min(a[i],a[i+1])); b.push(Math.max(a[i],a[i+1])); } else b.push(a[i]); } a=b; } return [...r,...a]; }
tasks.note: Knockout rounds between neighbours (a lone last element advances), the smaller loses; lists the losers in elimination order and then the winner.

tasks.name: מיון עם חוצץ
tasks.src: l=>{ const b=[], r=[]; for(const x of l){ b.push(x); if(b.length>2){ const m=Math.min(...b); r.push(m); b.splice(b.indexOf(m),1); } } return [...r,...b.sort((x,y)=>x-y)]; }
tasks.note: Reads the list through a buffer of three places, each time releasing the smallest buffered element, and finally releases the rest in increasing order.

tasks.name: שליפת חציונים
tasks.src: l=>{ const a=[...l].sort((x,y)=>x-y), r=[]; while(a.length) r.push(a.splice((a.length-1)>>1,1)[0]); return r; }
tasks.note: Repeatedly removes the lower median of what is left and lists the removed elements in order.

tasks.name: קיבוץ לפי זוגות ערכים
tasks.src: l=>{ const k=[]; for(const x of l) if(!k.includes(x>>1)) k.push(x>>1); return k.flatMap(g=>l.filter(x=>(x>>1)===g)); }
tasks.note: Groups elements that share the same value after halving (8-9, 10-11, ...), groups in order of first appearance, original order inside a group.

tasks.name: הקטע החלק הארוך
tasks.src: l=>{ let bs=0, bl=0, s=0; for(let i=0;i<=l.length;i++){ if(i===l.length||(i>0&&Math.abs(l[i]-l[i-1])>2)){ if(i-s>bl){ bl=i-s; bs=s; } s=i; } } return l.slice(bs,bs+bl); }
tasks.note: Returns the longest stretch in which neighbours differ by at most 2 (the first one on ties).

tasks.name: מיון שייקר
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l], n=r.length; for(let i=0;i+1<n;i++) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } for(let i=n-2;i>=0;i--) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Runs one cocktail-shaker round: a left-to-right bubble pass followed by a right-to-left pass.

tasks.name: סיבוב עד ירידה
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; if(r.length<2) return r; while(r[0]>r[r.length-1]) r.push(r.shift()); return r; }
tasks.note: Rotates left one step at a time until the first element is smaller than the last.

tasks.name: מיון במחסנית
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[], r=[]; for(const x of l){ while(s.length&&s[s.length-1]<x) r.push(s.pop()); s.push(x); } while(s.length) r.push(s.pop()); return r; }
tasks.note: Passes the list through one stack: before pushing an element, pops to the output every smaller element on top; finally pops the rest.
